# Pattern Statement Template

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| Recurring pattern | [What keeps happening?] |
| Visible symptoms | [Symptoms] |
| Affected stakeholders | [Stakeholders] |
| Time horizon | [Short / medium / long] |
| Current explanation | [How the organization currently explains it] |
| Alternative explanations | [Other plausible structures] |
| Why this pattern matters | [Strategic consequence] |

## Guardrail

Do not begin with the preferred solution. Begin with the recurring pattern.
